slots.notes: Brand mark reused in the navbar (w-8) and inside the hero's dropshadowed white icon box; single-color glyph that tints to the accent color (declared as three staggered blocks stepping up bottom-left to top-right).

Inline UI glyph set from lucide-react: Menu, X (mobile hamburger toggle), Folder, Check, Mail, Slack, Calendar, Clock, Timer used across navbar and the four floating decorative folder groups; some are color-tinted per-instance (Mail #EA4335, Slack #4A154B, Calendar #4285F4, Check on accent box).
Overlapping circular user/team avatars inside the 'Active Sprints' task cards (two cards x two avatars); placeholder source is DiceBear avataaars, to be replaced with brand team/persona avatars.

mechanic: A fixed navbar over a full-bleed white hero card (radial-dot noise) whose centered headline stack fades/slides up in a staggered cascade while four absolutely-positioned decorative folder UI clusters rotate and slide in around it on Framer Motion entrance delays.
techDelivery: React + Tailwind CSS component spec using Framer Motion (import { motion } from "motion/react") and lucide-react icons; Google Fonts (Inter, Caveat) via custom Tailwind theme tokens (--font-sans, --font-handwriting).
reskinNotes: Accent hex #2563EB is baked directly into the inline brand-logo SVG path fill (must be patched in markup, not via CSS); all copy, the multi-color task badges/avatars, lucide tint colors (#EA4335/#4A154B/#4285F4/#FF5722/#00C853), and progress-bar colors are hardcoded inline; layout uses fixed pixel folder widths (w-[450px]/w-[420px]) plus a responsive scale ladder (scale-[0.4]→lg:scale-90), so swapped assets and longer copy can break the absolute floating-block composition; the handwriting sticky note is font-metric-dependent (Caveat at 21px in a fixed w-56 box).
